summary.text: Gaius Dupio II is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Gregg Takayama.
A Pearl City resident whose work has included construction, he ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Gaius Dupio II was born in Honolulu and graduated from Pearl City High School.
His career experience includes work in construction and as a baker, forklift driver, grocery clerk and cashier.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up and lives in Pearl City, graduated in 2011 and worked at a Pearl City grocery store for 10 years.
Dupio lost the November 5, 2024 general election for District 34 to Takayama, then advanced from the Republican primary on August 8, 2026.
In the 2024 survey, he named reducing taxes as the policy area he is passionate about and said he wants to be transparent and responsive to residents' needs.
